question: site wise average change in shuttle run time from baseline to endline, negative means faster
gold_sql: SELECT b."Location", AVG(e."Shuttle Run sec" - b."Shuttle Run sec") AS avg_shuttle_change FROM sportathon_baseline AS b JOIN sportathon_endline AS e ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID" GROUP BY b."Location" ORDER BY b."Location"

attempts.response:
WITH changes AS (
    SELECT
        b."Location",
        e."Shuttle Run sec" - b."Shuttle Run sec" AS shuttle_run_change
    FROM "sportathon_baseline" b
    JOIN "sportathon_endline" e
        ON b."Child ID" = e."Child ID"
)
SELECT
    "Location",
    AVG(shuttle_run_change) AS avg_shuttle_run_change
FROM changes
GROUP BY "Location"
